The amber garden trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
In invented learning gardens, do guided sessions change learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Invented (synthetic) learning-garden trials supplied in the public fixture `fixture-001.json`
- Reports a recall outcome after guided sessions

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not present in the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome reported

## Query log
| Date | Source | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-07 | invented-index (supplied fixture, no live search) | all fixture records | 2 |

## Notes
Evaluation capture mode: corpus, claims, synthesis, and source texts are copied verbatim from the fixture. No external backends were queried.
The amber garden trial found no change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall (Vale, 2024).
